label: Returns and discounting
subgoals: Raise the discount to each step index
Multiply each reward by its discount weight
Sum the weighted rewards for the return

label: Sparse terminal rewards
subgoals: Identify the step at which the only nonzero reward arrives
Discount it by the discount factor to the power of steps elapsed
Compare the resulting weight across discount choices

label: Value estimates and TD error
subgoals: Discount the next state's value and add the reward
Interpret the sign as better or worse than expected
